morphology.pattern_note: 按外来专名整词处理，不拆成马来语词根和词缀。所列 IPA 是常见英国英语读法，实际称名以本人读法为准；资料包未提供音节或 Jawi。

senses.zh_definition: Carson：外来专名，可用作姓氏或名字，常音译为“卡森”；具体指谁须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: Carson, a surname or given name whose referent is determined by context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang digunakan sebagai nama keluarga atau nama individu; rujukannya bergantung pada konteks.
senses.nuances: 通常须大写 Carson。资料包没有 DBP 释义，故不标作已核实的官方普通词条；也无法据此确定具体人物。以下搭配是称名结构，不是已验证的高频词汇搭配。名字及常见英语读法见 [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/carson)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报；虚构称名示例
dual_scenarios.ms: Encik Carson akan membentangkan laporan projek dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: 卡森先生将在明天的会议上汇报项目报告。
dual_scenarios.en: Mr Carson will present the project report at tomorrow's meeting.

etymology.historical_story: Carson illustrates how a surname can become a personal name and then appear unchanged in Malay conversation. Its surname history includes Scottish and northern Irish associations, but its origin is not settled. A tempting split into familiar English pieces would therefore promise more certainty than the evidence supports. It remains a name, not a Malay derivation. See [FamilySearch](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=carson).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Carson 想成名牌上的“卡森”：它是在叫人，不是在表达一个马来语普通词义。
